title: The Empowered Thyroid Podcast
author: Dr. Rachel Vong, ND
description:
Have you been told your thyroid labs look "normal," but you still feel exhausted, struggle to lose weight, have brain fog, hair loss, bloating, anxiety, or just don't feel like yourself anymore?

You're not imagining it, and you're certainly not alone.

Welcome to The Empowered Thyroid Podcast, where we go beyond TSH and thyroid medication to uncover what's really driving hypothyroidism and Hashimoto's.

I'm Dr. Rachel Vong, a naturopathic doctor who has spent more than a decade helping women with thyroid disease uncover the root causes behind their symptoms. Every week, I'll break down complex thyroid topics into simple, practical conversations that actually make sense, so you can better understand your body and finally feel empowered to take control of your health.

We'll cover topics like:

• Why you still feel terrible on thyroid medication
 • Hashimoto's, thyroid antibodies, and the immune system connection
 • The full thyroid panel your doctor probably isn't running (and what the numbers actually mean)
 • How gut health, liver function, blood sugar, hormones, and stress all impact your thyroid
 • Weight loss with hypothyroidism
 • Fertility, pregnancy, and postpartum thyroid health
 • Fatigue, brain fog, anxiety, hair loss, and more

Most importantly, this podcast is here to remind you that there is always a reason why you feel the way you do.

Because when you understand your body, you can advocate for yourself with confidence and that's where healing begins.

description: Sky is the Limit, hosted by Sky Rueff. Engineer by training, obsessive by disposition. He spent three years building and testing a space farming payload out of a university lab, flew it past 100,000 feet, and now works systems engineering on an uncrewed lunar lander. He's also an audiophile, a drone builder and racer, and designs the things he prints. The show covers all of it, plus the questions that don't have hardware answers. What consciousness is. What reality is made of. Whether you're actually deciding anything. Complicated topics discussed the way they should be, digestible and understandable to anyone. The real limit is where you stop wondering.

The Half of It is what happens when two sisters who found each other later in life realize they have a lot more in common than DNA — including a love of crime, weird stories, family mysteries, dark humor, and asking way too many questions.

Chelsea and Kate share the same biological father, but grew up completely separate. Now they talk every day, usually about something bizarre, suspicious, hilarious, or all three.

Some episodes dig into cold cases and strange crimes. Some unravel stories from their own family. Some are just the two of them trying to understand how two people who barely knew the other existed can somehow sound alike, think alike, and have an alarming number of the same quirks.

They may not know the whole story.

Whether you're a lifelong music collector or simply love discovering something new, The Music Vault takes you beyond the studio albums to explore the stories behind the songs. title: Yellowstone National Park: Six Early Pieces
author: Various
description: Lost in the wilderness of The Yellowstone for over a month, nearly dying of starvation and wild animal attack, despairing of ever finding his way out. Here are six relatively unknown early pieces about the U.S.A.’s first national park. The first is a U.S. Geological booklet about initial exploration and Congress’s institution of the park. The next two are articles from Scribner’s Monthly, 1871, a very popular magazine of the time, describing the park’s features (vol 2 #1 pp 1-17 and vol 2 #2 pp 113-128) . The fourth piece is a narrative by the leader of the exploratory expedition described in the first piece, H.V. Hayden (Scribner’s Monthly, vol 3#2 pp 388-396, February 1872) The fifth piece is a lecture on the park by a very popular lecturer and writer, 1900 (John L. Stoddard’s Lectures, vol 10). The last piece is a man’s first-person narrative of his being lost in the Yellowstone wilderness for thirty-seven days, 1871, Scribner’s Monthly again (vol 3#1). - Summary by david wales

title: A banker's 110 day Vitagrit40 AI sprint
author: Ernex, UAB
description:
"AI & Me: The 110-Day Solo App Sprint"

Can you build a fully secured, production-grade mobile app from scratch at age 50 with absolute zero coding experience?

In this episode, we sit down with a former corporate banker and 1999 econometrics graduate who decided to rewrite his career path using generative AI. Equipped with a 110-day roadmap, a €10,000 budget, and a relentless drive, he embarked on Vilnius nights to build Vitagrit40—a premier fitness ecosystem designed specifically for men over 40.

This is not a theoretical talk about the "future of AI." It is a raw, honest, and highly practical post-mortem of a solo founder working side-by-side with LLMs to build real software.

What We Cover in This Episode:

The "Lexus & Takumi" Quality Oath: Why "good enough" is the death of a premium app. How our guest spent hours regenerating a simple burpee exercise graphic to achieve "90-second origami" perfection.

The Day the Secrets Leaked: A harrowing security crisis where the Claude API key was accidentally exposed three times in a single night—and the rapid-response rotation drills that saved the project.

The Clash of Law & Design: How we navigated the massive friction between Apple’s 5.1.1(v) mandatory account deletion policy and the legal necessity of keeping unalterable, immutable health survey records (PAR-Q+) for liability.

"Black Screen" Detective Work: Unmasking the layout crashes (the infamous RenderFlex unbounded height errors) that visual editors won't show you, and the genius iframe JS-hack used to bypass locked debug consoles.

The $387 SaaS Cost Shock: Learning cost discipline the hard way. How a surge in automated MCP sessions led to a massive usage-billing invoice from Anthropic, forcing an immediate pivot to flat-rate cost modeling.

Sailing by the Stars: The marine allegories that kept the ship on course—from locking the compass to refusing to sail with a hidden leak.

Whether you are a seasoned business leader, an aspiring creator, or someone looking to build a digital product with no tech background, this episode is your ultimate playbook on modern digital literacy, grit, and the raw reality of solo-founding in the age of AI.

Listen now and learn how to turn AI from a novelty chatbot into your ultimate software partner.

title: When Angels Cry
author: Barry KuKes
description:
Novella with a song soundtrack! Each chapter includes a song that is a reflection of the chapter.


In 1992, as her husband lies dying of AIDS, a woman is forced to confront the choices that shaped her life—and the love she never fully understood.

Caryn Jennings spent years searching for a way to be seen.


Leaving behind a quiet life in Western New York, she arrives in New York City determined to reinvent herself. In a world where beauty opens doors and invisibility closes them, Caryn learns quickly that attention can be earned—even if it comes at a cost. By her early twenties, she is surviving through choices that blur the line between control and surrender.


Everything changes when she meets Davy—a struggling writer whose quiet intensity and unwavering belief in her offer something she has never known: the possibility of being truly understood. As his success grows, so does the complexity of their relationship. Love becomes entangled with ambition, loyalty, and fear, leading to a fracture neither of them is prepared to face.


Years later, at the height of the AIDS crisis, Caryn is confronted with the devastating reality of the man she never stopped loving. In the shadow of illness, regret, and time lost, she must reconcile the life she built with the truth she avoided—and decide whether love can exist without possession, and whether forgiveness can come too late.

Each chapter is accompanied by a companion song, offering a deeper emotional reflection of the story’s most intimate moments. The novel stands on its own—but for those who choose to listen and look, the experience lingers long after the final page.

A haunting and intimate story of love, loss, and the need to be seen, When Angels Cry explores the fragile space between who we are… and who we allow others to know.

description:
The Playboy Philosophy — Hugh M. Hefner (1962) | Freedom, Pleasure & the Pursuit of Happiness.

Introduction: A Philosophy That Challenged the 1950s
The Playboy Philosophy, written by Hugh M. Hefner and published in 1962, is far more than a statement about the Playboy lifestyle. It is a cultural manifesto that reflects one of the most significant periods of social transformation in modern American history.At the beginning of the 1960s, American society was changing rapidly. The traditional values of the post-war era were increasingly being questioned by a younger generation seeking greater personal freedom, individuality and self-expression. Questions surrounding relationships, sexuality, marriage, gender roles, censorship, civil rights and personal happiness were entering public debate with unprecedented intensity.Against this background, Hugh M. Hefner presented The Playboy Philosophy as an argument for a different way of approaching life.Hefner challenged what he regarded as unnecessary restrictions imposed by society and encouraged individuals to think independently, enjoy life and pursue happiness according to their own values.The result is a fascinating historical document: provocative, controversial and deeply connected to the cultural transformation of the 1960s.This podcast presents The Playboy Philosophy as an exploration of Hefner's ideas about freedom, pleasure, relationships, culture and individual choice.

1. The Playboy Vision: Living Life on Your Own Terms
At the heart of Hefner's philosophy is a simple but provocative idea: life should be enjoyed.Rather than accepting the notion that pleasure must be sacrificed in the name of social conformity, Hefner argues that human beings should be able to pursue happiness, beauty, creativity and personal fulfillment.The "Playboy" in Hefner's philosophy is therefore presented not merely as a consumer of luxury or entertainment, but as a particular type of modern individual.He is curious.He appreciates art and literature.He enjoys music, conversation and sophisticated surroundings.He values personal freedom.And he refuses to accept every traditional social rule simply because it has existed for generations.This broader interpretation is important because The Playboy Philosophy extends beyond sexuality.Hefner connects pleasure with culture and intellectual curiosity. A fulfilling life, in his view, should include much more than physical enjoyment. It should involve reading, listening, thinking, discovering and participating in the cultural world.The philosophy therefore presents pleasure as something broader than hedonism.It is about appreciating life.It is about individuality.And it is about refusing to allow convention to determine every aspect of personal existence.

2. Sexual Freedom and the Changing Culture of America
One of the most controversial aspects of The Playboy Philosophy is Hefner's discussion of sexuality.In the conservative environment of the 1950s, open discussions about sexual desire were often restricted by social conventions, religious beliefs and censorship.Hefner challenged this culture directly.He argued that sexuality was a natural part of human life and that adults should be able to discuss sexual relationships openly rather than treating them as subjects of shame or secrecy.Consent, mutual respect, communication and personal choice become important elements in this vision.The significance of these arguments lies partly in their historical context.Ideas that might appear familiar in contemporary discussions of relationships were far more controversial when Hefner was writing.He questioned the assumption that traditional morality should automatically determine private behavior.He also challenged the idea that sexual desire itself was something that should be suppressed.For Hefner, sexual freedom formed part of a larger principle of individual liberty.People should have greater freedom to determine how they live their private lives, provided that their relationships are consensual and respectful.This philosophy contributed to the broader cultural conversation that would become increasingly visible throughout the 1960s and 1970s.

3. Marriage, Monogamy and Alternative Relationships
Another major theme explored in The Playboy Philosophy is the traditional institution of marriage.Hefner questions whether conventional expectations surrounding marriage and monogamy necessarily correspond to the realities of human desire and relationships.Rather than assuming that one model must work for everyone, he encourages readers to think critically about the structures society has created around love, sex and partnership.This does not mean that every individual must reject monogamy.Instead, Hefner's argument challenges the idea that there is only one legitimate way to organize adult relationships.The book therefore becomes part of a much larger debate about individuality and personal freedom.Can society determine what a successful relationship should look like?Should personal happiness always be subordinated to convention?Can individuals define relationships according to their own needs and values?These questions remain relevant today.Modern discussions about dating, marriage, divorce, open relationships and different forms of partnership continue to revisit many of the issues Hefner raised decades earlier.At the same time, the ideas presented in the book should be understood within their historical context.Hefner's vision was shaped by the culture, assumptions and gender dynamics of the early 1960s.Listening to the work today allows us not only to examine his arguments but also to consider how attitudes toward relationships and sexuality have changed over time.

4. Art, Literature, Music and the Playboy Lifestyle
The philosophy of Playboy is not limited to sexuality.Hefner also presents an ideal of cultural sophistication.Literature, art, music, cinema, architecture and conversation are important elements of the lifestyle he promotes.The Playboy ideal is therefore connected with the idea of becoming a well-rounded individual.Pleasure can come from reading a great book.It can come from listening to music.It can come from appreciating art.It can come from an intelligent conversation with another person.And it can come from exploring new ideas.This cultural dimension helped distinguish Playboy from publications that focused solely on entertainment or sexuality.Hefner wanted the Playboy identity to be associated with modernity, sophistication and intellectual curiosity.The Playboy Philosophy consequently offers an interesting perspective on the relationship between popular culture and intellectual life.It asks readers to consider whether pleasure and intellectual development really need to be opposites.Hefner's answer is clearly no.A person can seek pleasure while remaining intellectually curious.Entertainment and education can coexist.Physical enjoyment and cultural appreciation can exist within the same life.This idea of balance is central to Hefner's broader vision.

5. Freedom, Civil Rights and Social Change
Perhaps one of the more significant aspects of The Playboy Philosophy is its connection to broader questions of freedom and social justice.Hefner's philosophy was not exclusively concerned with private pleasure. Playboy also became associated with debates surrounding civil rights, racial equality, freedom of expression and social progress.Hefner argued that personal freedom should not exist in isolation.If society claims to value freedom, then that freedom should extend to people regardless of race, gender or social background.This makes the book part of the wider cultural transformation taking place in America during the 1960s.The traditional social order was being questioned from multiple directions.Civil rights activists were challenging racial segregation and discrimination.Women were increasingly challenging restrictive gender expectations.Young people were questioning established institutions.Artists and writers were pushing against censorship.And debates about sexuality were becoming increasingly visible.The Playboy Philosophy belongs to this broader historical movement.Whether one agrees with Hefner's arguments or not, the book provides an opportunity to understand the ideas and cultural tensions that helped define an era.

title: MEMOIRS OF CASANOVA: Story of My Life
author: Giacomo Casanova
description:
THE MEMOIRS OF JACQUES CASANOVA de SEINGALT - THE STORY OF MY LIFE: The Extraordinary Memoirs, Adventures, Loves and Escapes of an 18th-Century Adventurer.

Few autobiographies have captured the imagination of the world like The Story of My Life, the extraordinary memoirs of Giacomo Casanova (1725–1798).

Born in Venice in the eighteenth century, Casanova lived a life that seems almost impossible to believe. He was a priest, soldier, musician, gambler, writer, intellectual, diplomat, adventurer, prisoner, fugitive and notorious lover. He moved through the courts, salons, convents, gambling houses and prisons of Europe, crossing paths with aristocrats, artists, philosophers, politicians and women from every level of society.

But Casanova's memoirs are far more than a catalogue of romantic encounters. They form a remarkable portrait of eighteenth-century Europe—a world of aristocratic privilege, religious authority, political intrigue, elaborate social rituals, intellectual revolution, travel, gambling, wealth, poverty and personal freedom.

This podcast presents The Story of My Life as an epic journey through Casanova's adventures, following the memoir from his childhood in Venice through his travels across Europe and ultimately into old age. Across six volumes and thirty episodes, listeners will accompany Casanova from Venice to Paris, Amsterdam, London, Berlin, Moscow, Madrid, Rome, Naples, Switzerland, Germany and beyond.

VOLUME 1 — VENETIAN YEARS
The journey begins in Casanova's native Venice, where his extraordinary personality and appetite for adventure first begin to develop.
1. CHILDHOOD (1-7)
The opening chapters introduce Casanova's early years and the world that shaped him. We encounter his family, education, childhood experiences and first encounters with religion, society and the opposite sex. These chapters reveal the young Casanova before he became the legendary figure associated with his name.
2. CLERIC IN NAPLES (8-12)
Casanova enters the world of the Church and travels to Naples. His experiences as a young cleric expose him to religious institutions, aristocratic society and the contradictions between public morality and private desire.
3. MILITARY CAREER (13-15)
Seeking a different path, Casanova turns toward military life. His brief career introduces him to discipline, travel and the realities of eighteenth-century military society, while his restless character continues to resist conventional expectations.
4. RETURN TO VENICE (16-19)
Casanova returns to Venice, the city that remains central to his identity. His fortunes begin to change as he becomes increasingly involved in the city's social world and discovers new opportunities for adventure.
5. MILAN AND MANTUA (20-23)
His travels continue through northern Italy. Milan and Mantua become stages for new friendships, romances, intrigues and unexpected encounters, demonstrating the extraordinary mobility of European society in Casanova's time.

VOLUME 2 — TO PARIS AND PRISON
The second volume brings Casanova into a more dangerous phase of his life. His ambitions expand, his reputation grows, and his adventures increasingly place him in conflict with authority.
6. PARIS
Paris opens a new chapter in Casanova's life. He encounters French society, wealth, culture and intellectual life while attempting to establish himself in one of Europe's most influential capitals.
7. VENICE
Returning to Venice, Casanova becomes deeply involved in the city's social and romantic world. His intelligence, charm and appetite for risk continue to create both opportunities and enemies.
8. CONVENT AFFAIRS
Casanova's adventures take him into the mysterious world of convents and forbidden relationships. These chapters combine secrecy, romance, religion and social convention in classic Casanova fashion.
9. THE FALSE NUN
Intrigue reaches another level as deception and disguise become central to the story. The episode illustrates Casanova's fascination with secrecy, identity and the boundaries imposed by eighteenth-century society.
10. UNDER THE LEAD
SCasanova's freedom finally comes to an end when he is imprisoned beneath the famous Leads of Venice. These chapters recount one of the most dramatic episodes of his entire life: his imprisonment, psychological struggle and extraordinary escape.

VOLUME 3 — THE ETERNAL QUEST
Freedom once again sends Casanova onto the roads of Europe. The third volume follows his continuing search for fortune, intellectual stimulation, companionship and adventure.
11. PARIS AND HOLLAND
Casanova travels through France and Holland, encountering new social circles, financial opportunities and romantic adventures. His life becomes increasingly international.
12. RETURN TO PARIS
Back in Paris, Casanova becomes immersed once again in the sophisticated world of French society. He pursues opportunities while navigating friendships, money, romance and reputation.
13. HOLLAND AND GERMANY
The journey continues northward. Holland and Germany provide new environments and new acquaintances, showing Casanova's remarkable ability to adapt wherever he goes.
14. SWITZERLAND
Switzerland introduces Casanova to a different landscape and culture. His travels become as important as his personal relationships, revealing Europe as a vast network of interconnected societies.
15. WITH VOLTAIRE
One of the intellectual highlights of the memoir arrives with Casanova's encounter with Voltaire. Their meeting brings together two extraordinary personalities of the Enlightenment and provides a glimpse into the intellectual world of eighteenth-century Europe.

VOLUME 4 — ADVENTURES IN THE SOUTH
The fourth volume takes Casanova back toward Italy and the Mediterranean world, where his appetite for adventure remains undiminished.
16. DEPART SWITZERLAND
Casanova leaves Switzerland and resumes his restless journey. New encounters and unexpected opportunities once again shape his path.
17. RETURN TO ITALY
Italy welcomes him back. The familiar landscape of Italian cities becomes the setting for new relationships, schemes and adventures.
18. RETURN TO NAPLES
Casanova returns to Naples, reconnecting with the world he encountered during his youth. The city provides another stage for romance, intrigue and personal transformation.
19. BACK AGAIN TO PARIS
Paris once again draws Casanova back. His repeated returns demonstrate the importance of the French capital in his European life and ambitions.
20. MILAN
Milan becomes another major stop in his continuing travels. Casanova's experiences reveal both the pleasures and uncertainties of life as an eighteenth-century adventurer without a permanent home.

VOLUME 5 — TO LONDON AND MOSCOW
Casanova's world expands even further in Volume Five. He travels across Western and Eastern Europe, encountering cultures increasingly distant from his Venetian origins.
21. SOUTH OF FRANCE
The journey begins in southern France, where Casanova encounters new people, landscapes and opportunities. His experiences continue to demonstrate his remarkable ability to enter unfamiliar social worlds.
22. TO LONDON
Casanova travels to London, one of Europe's great commercial and cultural centers. British society presents him with new customs, personalities and challenges.
23. THE ENGLISH
His encounters with English society provide a fascinating portrait of eighteenth-century Britain through the eyes of a foreign adventurer.
24. FLIGHT FROM LONDON TO BERLIN
Casanova leaves London and heads toward Berlin. His journey becomes increasingly unpredictable as political circumstances, personal relationships and financial concerns influence his movements.
25. RUSSIA AND POLAND
Casanova ventures into Eastern Europe, reaching Russia and Poland. These chapters broaden the geographical scope of the memoir and reveal his encounters with unfamiliar cultures, rulers and political environments.

VOLUME 6 — SPANISH PASSIONS
The final volume follows Casanova through Spain, Italy and the last stages of his extraordinary existence.
26. SPAIN
Spain becomes the setting for another major chapter of Casanova's European adventure. He encounters Spanish customs, personalities and passions while continuing his endless search for opportunity.
27. EXPELLED FROM SPAIN
Casanova's adventures once again bring him into conflict with authority. His expulsion demonstrates the risks that accompanied his unconventional lifestyle.

author: SWELL Collective
description:
Join sex therapists Dr. Danielle Armour and Dr. Ashley Sweet as they combine data-driven sex education with Millennial wit to destigmatize pleasure, untangle relationship dynamics, and answer the sex questions you’re usually too afraid to Google. Consider this your weekly dose of unapologetic, science-backed pleasure ed—served quick, with a side of good vibes.
Find them on IG @quickiewithavibe

title: Emerging Evidence Podcast
author: Leah
description:
Emerging Evidence is the podcast about Australian health and mental health research as it happens. Registered nurse

Leah Veenhuizen talks with the researchers behind current studies and trials, in plain language, including the ones offering free programs to everyday people right now.

title: Before It Begins
author: Impala & Peacock
description: Five minutes with a cup of tea, every weekday morning. Pour the water, watch the colour arrive, and hear one true thing about what's in the cup — why lemon myrtle carries more lemon than a lemon does, why hibiscus isn't a flower, why no ginger plant has ever been found growing wild. Then one thought worth carrying into the day. A new blend each week, Monday to Friday. Made by Impala & Peacock Artisan Teas, blended by hand in Melbourne. Best taken with something steeping.

title: The Intent Podcast: Leveraging Lessons from the TV Industry to Help Organisations Create Intentional Idea and Opportunity Flows
author: Intent
description:
Welcome to the Intent podcast, where industry experts Claire Tavernier and Richard Vargas explore the world of TV production. Join us as we delve into the intricate process of selecting, developing, and managing new TV show ideas. Our guests, including top producers, writers, and executives, share their valuable insights to help you make better business decisions.As a $500bn/yr global industry, television has become a master of creativity at scale. With tens of thousands of new shows launching every year and existing ones constantly evolving, the TV industry has honed its ability to manage a constant pipeline of fresh ideas.Whether you're in the TV industry or another business sector, you'll gain a deeper understanding of how to manage a constant pipeline of new ideas and navigate the complexities of the ideation process.If you’re interested in learning how we at Intent can help you select the right business opportunities, say ‘no’ to the wrong ones, and scale your growth, head over to our website at www.weareintent.com. 

[Music cues and sound effects credits: SergeQuadrado and Borys Kozielski from Pixabay]

title: Emotional Alchemy
author: Baylee Summer
description:
This is the Emotional Alchemy podcast, where high-sensitives, entrepreneurs, and those in the depths of transition receive the codes to emotional alchemy; a process of somatically feeling your emotions to free up your energy, heal old wounds, cultivate a deep connection with yourself…

And, in it’s most uniquely potent form, emotional alchemy has the power to transmute deep suffering into euphoric bliss.

In this podcast, we’ll explore how to live in a way that feels beautiful—in both ease and pain.

I’m your host, Baylee Summer. A business & emotional alchemy coach, and lifelong horsewoman with an obsession for connecting: to myself, my body, the earth, and the beautiful souls around me—human and animal alike.

Thank you for being here. Let’s dive deep.

title: It’s An Us Thing
author: Brett and Christina Varvel
description: Life was never meant to be lived separately—and neither was following Jesus. It’s An Us Thing with Brett & Christina Varvel is an honest, faith-filled conversation about marriage, parenting, calling, suffering, hope, laughter, and everyday life. Through storytelling, vulnerability, and biblical truth, Brett and Christina bring real-life stories back to Jesus and invite you to pursue Him together—wherever life takes you. Come listen in as they bring the Gospel into real life—and discover what happens when “me” becomes “us,” and “us” keeps pointing back to Him.

title: The Possibilist Podcast (PSSBLST)
author: Justin Perkins
description: Stories of adventure and lessons in wisdom from Justin Perkins and his network of founders, artists, leaders, athletes, and adventurers and Possibilists. This podcast explores the wonder and grit required to be a successful modern human, bringing big ideas into the world, with an emphasis on the Founder to CEO journey that is the ultimate modern rite of passage for creative humans. Host Justin Perkins is a serial entrepreneur, author, and founder coach, a former competitive athlete, musician and world adventurer. This podcast includes a mix of reflective rite-of-passage experiences, stories, and interviews with exceptional possibilists, intimate coaching sessions that led to breakthroughs, and a deep exploration of possibilism - a skill that anyone can develop.  Possibilism is an upgrade to optimism - it is "someone who neither hopes without reason nor fears without reason, but sees progress because they are willing to look honestly at reality." And you will join the Possible List - a network of Possibilists - in creating your own list of what's possible.

title: Mr. Content Talkshow
author: Akash Jaiswal
description: This podcast will cover topics related to branding , social.media , storytelling , copywriting , marketing , persuasion and much more related to human behavior.

title: The Educator's Why
author: Doug Yarbrough and Tori Sinco
description:
Behind every educator is a story—a journey filled with challenges, victories, lessons learned, and an unwavering commitment to students. This podcast goes beyond the headlines and the classroom to uncover the heart of education: the people who dedicate their lives to making a difference.
In each episode, we'll sit down with teachers, principals, superintendents, and education leaders to explore their personal journeys, the experiences that shaped them, and the purpose that fuels their work every day. Along the way, we'll discuss leadership, innovation, policy, technology, and the future of ed

title: Holy-ish The perfect place for people who aren’t
author: lisavoorhies
description:
Welcome to Holyish—the podcast for people who love Jesus and want to do real life. No fake it til ya make it here. 

If you've ever wrestled with insecurity, comparison, perfectionism, shame, or simply wondered if you're doing this faith thing right, you're in good company. Around here, we believe God isn't looking for perfect people—He's transforming willing ones.

Each week, you'll find honest conversations, biblical encouragement, practical wisdom, a few laughs, and plenty of reminders that God's grace is bigger than your mistakes. We'll talk about identity in Christ, spiritual growth, confidence, purpose, relationships, and learning to trust a perfect God instead of trying to become a perfect person.

So grab your coffee, come as you are, and join us. Because we're all a little Holyish—and that's exactly where God's grace meets us.

New episodes every week.

title: Philippines Passport Renewal
author: Zulfkar Ali
description: Learn the DFA Passport Renewal process, and find why renewal matters. We will also disucss requirements, fee, procedure, and more.

title: Meet The Collective
author: G-Woman Radio
description:
The Meet the Collective is a weekly live radio show on G-Woman Radio that introduces listeners to the remarkable women who make up the G-Woman Collective. Each episode hosted by Alex Okoroji features two members in an engaging, light-hearted conversation where they share who they are, what they do, what inspires them, and the experiences that have shaped their journeys.

Rather than formal interviews, the show feels like sitting around the table with friends, full of laughter, surprises, meaningful conversations, and genuine human connection. By giving members a platform to be seen, heard, and celebrated, the program strengthens relationships across the Collective while inspiring global listeners through authentic stories from everyday women creating extraordinary impact.

title: DN4 - A Doncaster Rovers podcast
author: Liam Hoden and Robbie Andrews
description: Analysis, debate and discussion on all things Doncaster Rovers from two experts on the club, Robbie Andrews and Liam Hoden with some special guests along for the ride.

title: The United Foundry
author: Listening Dog Media
description:
An independent Manchester United fan channel hosted by Gaz Drinkwater, bringing United supporters the latest news, honest opinions and proper debate on everything happening at Old Trafford.

Expect regular Manchester United transfer updates, match previews, instant reactions, weekly podcasts, player analysis, interviews and discussion around the biggest stories affecting the club.

Gaz is joined by guests, contributors and supporters to break down performances, transfers and the decisions shaping Manchester United — without the noise, agendas or recycled talking points.

Whether you are watching from Manchester or supporting United from anywhere in the world, subscribe and become part of The United Foundry.

Manchester United. Forged through discussion.

title: The Premier Optical Eye Care Podcast
author: Premier Optical
description: Clear, practical conversations about eye health, vision tests, eyeglasses, contact lenses, lens technology, and everyday visual comfort. Each episode turns Premier Optical’s eye-care guides into useful information that helps individuals and families understand their vision, prepare for eye exams, and make informed eyewear choices.

description:
Reporting & interviews for thoughtful travelers, immigrants and expats who want to engage with art in Barcelona
© 2026 Casita Cocco Radio. All rights reserved.

title: Tarot for Humans
author: Lindsay Nelson | Pink Moon Audio
description:
What if Tarot wasn't about predicting the future, but helping you make sense of the exact moment you're in?
Tarot for Humans is a series of mini-episodes that feel like voice notes from your witchy best bud or your sorta bossy big sis (because I'm all of those things 💖).
Using Tarot as a tool for reflection and POV-shifting, each episode explores a specific life moment: from overthinking a text to starting something new to feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or ready for a change.
No gatekeeping. No fortune-telling. Just perspective, a little magic, and tools for navigating real life.

title: Streetmotherz Podcast
author: Tiffany Davis
description:
Our Podcast will deliver a rollercoaster of raw emotions, stories and hardships of being a product of our environment.
We talk about the harsh realities of the streets. The struggles of being involved and/or raising children that are in the streets. Many don't understand what we've seen and even been through. We are here to share with the world our stories.
Warning: Our content may be offensive to some viewers.
We will allow our platform to be a safe space for guest to express themselves. We don't judge, we listen.

description: Our 20-year marriage has been anything but ordinary—filled with laughter, tears, victories, and struggles. We’ve known the weight of trying to make it on our own and the freedom of building a marriage centered on Christ. On the Still Going Strong (?) Podcast, we open the door to honest conversations about love, faith, forgiveness, and perseverance. We don’t pretend to have all the answers, but we do know this: Christ makes all the difference. Our hope is to encourage you, make you laugh, and remind you that with Him, your marriage can stand.

title: Jake’s Reddit Stories
author: Jake’s Reddit Stories
description: Hey, I'm Jake. I read the craziest Reddit stories so you don't have to. Relationship drama, workplace disasters, family chaos – all the good stuff. Perfect for background listening while you do literally anything else. New stories all the time.

title: A- List Kitchen with Chef Keis Briscoe
author: chefkeisbriscoe
description: A List Kitchen is where great food, good conversation, and A-List energy come together. Hosted by Chef Keis Briscoe, the series goes beyond the headlines, helping viewers get to know the person behind the personality. While preparing and sharing a meal, guests open up about their journeys, passions, challenges, and the experiences that shaped who they are. Through authentic conversations and unforgettable moments, A List Kitchen creates a space where food becomes the connection and every story has a seat at the table.

title: Converse With Kaffy Podcast
author: Kafayat Gbajabiamila
description:
Converse with Kaffy is a podcast for anyone navigating the beautiful, messy, and meaningful journey of life.


Hosted by Kaffy, each episode invites you into honest conversations about the things we often think about but don't always talk about; purpose, relationships, growth, identity, resilience, work, family, faith, failure, hope, and everything in between.


This isn't a place where anyone pretends to have all the answers. It's a space to ask thoughtful questions, share real experiences, and learn together, one conversation at a time.


Whether you're celebrating a new beginning, facing an unexpected challenge, or simply looking for conversations that leave you feeling encouraged and understood, there's a seat for you here.


Pull up a chair. There's room for you here.

A radical self-honesty podcast designed to bring new perspectives on life’s challenges and traumas. 


“The truth never changes, but your relationship with it can!” - Samantha Gunn

title: Confrontation Station
author: Masseeh Radfar & Craig McLoughlin
description:
Confrontation Station breaks down real confrontations, high-pressure situations and moments where people are forced to make split-second decisions.
Using viral videos, public interactions and real-world incidents, we analyze body language, psychology, escalation, de-escalation, authority, confidence, persuasion and the choices people make when emotions take over. From arguments and street confrontations to police encounters, workplace disputes and everyday conflicts, every episode asks the same question: why did people react the way they did?
Hosted by Massey and Craig, Confrontation Station is about understanding human behaviour when the pressure is on.

title: Food Noise Is Not the Villain You Think It Is
author: Daryl Perry
description:
Food noise has become a huge part of the conversation around eating, weight loss, and GLP-1 medications. But what does food noise actually mean to you?
Hosted by Daryl Perry of Your Level Fitness, this podcast takes a more nuanced look at the thoughts, feelings, habits, and experiences we often group together as food noise. No fear, guilt, shame, or one-size-fits-all answers. Just honest conversations to help you better understand your relationship with food and find what works for you for life.

title: The Unintended School

title: AMBS UNFILTERED with Amber Greaves
author: amber greaves
description: Ambs Unfiltered is your new weekly dose of real talk with your internet bestie, host Amber Greaves. Join this 29-year-old entrepreneur, creator, and pop culture fanatic as she serves up unfiltered advice on life, business, relationships, and chasing your biggest goals. Need a happy escape? Want to feel motivated to take control of your life? Press play and settle in—it’s time for some encouraging, feel-good vibes designed to remind you that it's never too late to go after your dreams.

title: Dear Self : Navigating Through 20s
author: Jerlyn Sagayaraj
description: Time to do a reality check🥂 - your twenties are a chaotic cocktail of trying to build a career, surviving timeline anxiety, and wondering if eating sugary cereal for dinner counts as self-care (spoiler: it does). We are breaking down the comparison olympics, social media curation fatigue, and corporate guilt with zero filter. We aren’t experts; we’re just figuring out how to protect our peace and choose our own happiness. Consider this a love letter, a guide, and a warm hug to your evolving self. Hit subscribe, grab your matcha or whatever drink, and let’s navigate the plot twists together.✨

title: Echo 24: Conversations
author: KaayRizzy
description: Echo 24 is a media space built around real conversations, personal growth, and storytelling. The platform explores identity, mindset, discipline, relationships, and the ongoing process of becoming who you’re meant to be. Through interviews and honest dialogue, Echo 24 highlights different perspectives on life, growth, and self-discovery. Every episode is rooted in truth, reflection, and evolution—no filters, no perfection, just real conversation.

title: The Tarah and Barry Show
author: Tarah and Barry
description:
Welcome to "The Tarah and Barry Show," your weekly deep dive into the world of ADHD in life and love!


Every Monday AND Thursday, join us for a blend of playful banter, insightful stories, and actionable advice, as we unpack what it's like living with ADHD and navigating it in romantic relationships. 


We're not here to tell you that ADHD is your superpower. But we are here to help you understand yourself, feel seen, and offer real, transformative strategies to work with your ADHD, rather than against it.


Whether you're self-diagnosed, have a formal diagnosis, or are simply curious about ADHD, our show has something special for you.


Are you ready to join the family? Hit that subscribe button, become a part of our FREE Facebook community, or elevate your experience by joining our exclusive "Neurospicy Family Membership." Let's embrace ADHD together and thrive in love and life.

title: English speakers
author: Nouredine Nachite
description: Tune in to Episode 3 for all things English! From essential vocabulary to conversational phrases, this episode is a must-listen for beginners diving into the language. Packed with tips, tricks, and engaging exercises, you'll boost your language skills in no time. Don't miss out on leveling up your English game with Episode 3 - your ticket to fluency starts here!

title: Redemption Stories
author: Carrie Newman
description: In this episode of Redemption Stories, host Carrie Newman shares her personal testimony of redemption, healing, and restoration through Jesus Christ. Drawing from the biblical accounts of the Prodigal Son and the Woman at the Well, Carrie reflects on her own struggles with past trauma, fear, and broken relationships, and how God's grace transformed her life and marriage. This devotional podcast encourages listeners to trust God's plan, embrace His forgiveness, and discover how their own stories can bring them closer to Him

title: Faith and Favor
author: Joanne Gabriel
description:
Faith & Favor is a Christian podcast hosted by Joanne Gabriel, where faith meets healing through honest conversations about shields, stories, and salvation. 
Every episode unpacks a protective shield we often build because of sin, pain, or trauma—such as hyper-independence, self-preservation, or fear. Joanne then shares the personal story behind each shield and reveals how Jesus lovingly dismantles those defenses to bring true freedom and restoration. 
Join Joanne and guests to discover that our greatest protection isn't the walls we build, but the Savior who makes us whole.

title: Build to Last
author: Build to Last
description: Built to Last is the podcast for people who want to build big things from the ground up. A mix of self-development and infrastructure finance, no unnecessary jargon, just concrete ideas to help you grow, in your career and in your life.

title: The Aging Well Blueprint
author: Rodger
description: The Aging Well Blueprint is a practical health and wellness podcast designed to help you understand how everyday choices affect the way you age. Each episode explores nutrition, hydration, strength, mobility, heart and brain health, sleep, stress, preventive health, and the simple daily habits that can help you stay active, independent, and engaged for years to come.

title: The Unfiltered Frequency
author: Bonnie Comfort
description:
The Unfiltered Frequency is where nothing is off-limits. From paranormal encounters and unexplained phenomena to music trends, entertainment, interviews, and culture, we dive into the conversations others won’t. Raw opinions, real stories, unexpected perspectives, and completely unfiltered conversations—tuning into the frequency beyond the ordinary.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/the-unfiltered-frequency--7248252/support.

Hosted by Kaleb Cavalier, each episode breaks down the latest from all 16 Eastern NHL teams, covers the top Eastern PWHL squads, and features engaging history segments. The show also analyzes major Western Conference moves through an Eastern Conference lens.
New episodes every Friday at noon ET

title: The Eternal Thread
author: Rajesh Chowdhry, Your Fellow Traveler
description:
The Eternal Thread is a quiet space for exploring how consciousness, attention, and realization shape the reality we live in.
Drawing from quantum field perspectives and classical Indian thought, these conversations look at how we participate in the world — not as distant observers, but as part of the field itself.
Topics include mind and language, the accumulation of realization, the illusion of separation, and the path toward Mukti. This is not a podcast of final answers. It is an invitation to look more carefully at how we see, speak, and take part in reality.

title: Deep and Ridiculous with Anthony Marino
author: Anthony Marino
description:
Where Wisdom meets Humour.
Conversations about life that make you think Deeply and laugh Ridiculously.

title: Audio Fiction FM
author: Marisa Ewing
description:
Created by Hemlock Creek Productions, Audio Fiction FM is a show for those looking to discover new audio fiction, whether you've been enjoying audio only shows for years or are looking to start listening for the first time. Host Marisa Ewing-Moody, audio drama editor and creator of "Liars & Leeches," will share news from the audio fiction world, the first episode of a piece of audio fiction, and an interview with that show's creators.


Join us for the premiere of Audio Fiction FM on our YouTube, August 12th at 8:00pm central time, where you can chat in real time with fans and audio drama creators as you listen. If you miss the premiere, or would prefer to listen to an audio only version, all episodes will be uploaded wherever you get your podcasts.


New episodes will be released on the second Wednesday of every month.


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Podcasting and AI
author: John Jamingo
description: Podcasting and A.I. follows John Jamingo as he learns artificial intelligence in real time, on camera, mistakes and all. No scripts, no fake expertise, just a working podcaster figuring out how AI can actually help with research, production, and post-production, one fumble at a time. If you make podcasts and you're curious about AI but a little intimidated by it, this is the show that proves you can learn as you go, right alongside him and his AI co-host Claudette.

title: Stories We Inherit: History Through Their Eyes
author: Sophie and Isabel
description: Stories We Inherit explores the stories, memories, and histories beyond the textbooks we read in class. Through the personal perspectives of the older generation, we uncover the untold stories behind historical events across the world, giving voice to the experiences, memories, and lessons that are often left out of the history books. These are the stories passed down through generations that continue to shape who we are today.

title: The Conscious Leaders UNFILTERED
author: Cheryl x Kiah
description:
What if leadership isn't about the people you manage—but about how you show up every single day?
The Conscious Leaders Unfiltered is where authentic conversations meet conscious living. Join Cheryl and co-host Kiah as they explore the real, unfiltered side of leadership—self-leadership, relationships, emotional intelligence, purpose, courage, and growth. Because conscious leadership isn't a title. It's a way of living, loving, and leading that creates lasting impact—whether you're leading one person or many.

title: The Iron Parable Podcast
author: rebekahj
description: The Iron Parable is a storytelling podcast that uses real faith journeys to sharpen faith, foster spiritual growth, and invite listeners into deeper walks with Christ.

title: Post Road Christian Church
author: PRCC
description: Welcome to the podcast of the weekly sermon from Post Road Christian Church in Indianapolis, Indiana. Each week, join us for biblical teaching designed to encourage, challenge, and help you grow in your relationship with Jesus.

title: The Truth, Half-Truths, Assumptions and Outright Lies Podcast
author: Chuck Bongiovanni
description:
"The Truth, Half-Truths, Assumptions & Outright Lies" podcast will be where local politics meets late-night comedy. If "Meet the Press" and the "Howard Stern Show" had a baby, it'd be this podcast. 

We separate facts from friction, laugh at the absurd, challenge and roast everyone equally, while holding local leaders accountable. If you're easily offended, this may not be your show. If you appreciate transparency, wit, and sarcasm all mixed in with a good laugh, welcome aboard. 

Keep your hands inside the vehicle at all times and check your feelings at the door.  Coming soon wherever you get your podcasts.  Remember the last laugh wins.

title: The CCT Podcast
author: Critical Communications Today
description:
The CCT Podcast is the official podcast from Critical Communications Today, hosted by editor Philip Mason.
Each episode brings together voices from across the critical communications, public safety and technology sectors to explore the ideas, innovations and real-world challenges shaping modern communications and emergency response.
Featuring industry leaders, emergency services professionals and technology experts, The CCT Podcast covers the trends, experiences and developments influencing mission-critical communications and the wider world of connected technology, resilience and public safety.
With insightful conversations and expert perspectives, The CCT Podcast provides a platform for the people driving change across the sector, whilst also offering a wider look at how technology, communication and innovation continue to shape the world around us.

title: Satires and Profanities
author: George William Foote, James Thomson
description: "Believing as I do that James Thomson is, since Shelley, the most brilliant genius who has wielded a pen in the service of Freethought, I take a natural pride and pleasure in rescuing the following articles from burial in the great mausoleum of the periodical press. There will doubtless be a diversity of opinion as to their value. One critic, for instance, has called “The Story of a Famous Old Jewish Firm” a witless squib; but, on the other hand, the late Professor Clifford considered it a piece of exquisite mordant satire worthy of Swift. Such differences are inevitable from the very nature of the subject. Satire, more than any other form of composition, rouses antipathy where it does not command applause; and the greater the satire, the more intense are the feelings it excites." (G. W. Foote in his Preface)

description:
Everybody takes punches. The comeback is the story.

Can’t Catch a Break is a long-form interview podcast about resilience, perseverance, and the human ability to come back from the moments that were supposed to break us.


Hosted by Reece Arthur, each episode sits down with someone who has been through a season when life simply would not let up. The circumstances are different—loss, addiction, illness, failure, heartbreak, career setbacks, unexpected change, or moments when everything seemed to fall apart—but the conversation doesn’t end with what went wrong.


Because Can’t Catch a Break isn’t a pity party.


We talk about the first punch. The hardest punch. Who was in their corner. What it really took to get back up. And how they’re punching back.


These are honest conversations about the parts of resilience that don't always look inspirational while you're living them—the people who show up, the days you barely make it through, the decisions that change your direction, and the moment surviving begins turning into rebuilding.

Some guests you'll know. Others you won't. Their stories may be completely different from yours.

But everyone knows what it feels like to get hit by life.


The punch gets us into the story. The comeback is why we stay.


Welcome to Can’t Catch a Break.

Taking Life’s Punches. And Punching Right Back.

Every episode gives its verdict in the first few minutes, says its sources out loud, and ends with who should skip this — pregnant or nursing listeners, and anyone taking medication, especially blood thinners. Named, not sold to. No miracles, no urgency, no pressure. If the honest answer is "ask your pharmacist," that is the answer you will hear.

SOLEY is a supplement brand from MONEGASQUE LLC, and it makes an aged garlic complex — details in the show notes. Say the name like the French word for sun: soh-LAY. See you on the sunny side.

This show is made with AI narration by the SOLEY team.

title: CANDID ON CALLING | Purpose, Clarity, Confidence, Discernment, God’s Plan, Midlife, Christian Women, Identity in Christ
author: Arris Charles | Life Purpose Coach for Christian Women
description:
Have you spent years wondering how to find your life purpose, but still feel uncertain about God’s calling on your life?
Do you find yourself holding back from the purpose God has placed on your heart because of doubt or fear?
Are you tired of second-guessing yourself or wondering whether you’re truly following God’s plan?
Are you ready to stop feeling stuck and unfulfilled and start living with clarity, confidence, and peace about who God created you to be and what He’s calling you to do?
I’m so glad you’re here!
In this Christian women’s podcast on life purpose, we get candid on calling, going beneath the surface to explore God’s truth, the path to clarity and confidence, and the real-life questions, challenges, and growth that come with pursuing your purpose as a Christian woman, especially in midlife and times of transition.
Through biblical wisdom, practical insights, and honest conversations, you’ll find guidance and encouragement for embracing your God-given identity, discerning your unique calling, aligning with God’s leading, and living purposefully in every season.
If you’re ready to stop wondering, wandering, and waiting and start becoming and fulfilling all God has purposed for you, Candid on Calling is the right place for you.
Hi, I’m Arris. Years ago, I was in a role that seemed to give me a good life on the outside, but it wasn’t giving me life on the inside. Deep down, I felt a longing that wouldn’t go away to find the true purpose God had for me and understand how He wanted to use my life. As I became more intentional about drawing closer to God and seeking His direction, I eventually walked away from where I was so I could make space to discover where He was leading me. In the process, I found much greater clarity about what I was called to do.
But even after finding that clarity, I discovered that knowing what I was called to do wasn’t enough. Self-doubt, fear, limiting beliefs, and the challenges of everyday life were still holding me back from fully stepping into it.
What I learned is that walking in your calling isn’t just about knowing what you’re called to do. It’s about learning to see yourself the way God sees you, recognizing what God has placed within you and the patterns He has been revealing throughout your life. And as you trust His leading, you can take steps of faith and courage, even in difficult seasons.
That’s why I’m passionate about helping Christian women grow in the clarity, confidence, courage, and faith to live out God’s purpose for their lives.
Are you longing to make the difference God created you to make? Whether you don’t yet know your specific purpose, have a general sense of it but need more direction, or find yourself struggling to move forward in what you’re called to do, I’d love to walk alongside you.
If you’re a Christian woman who wants to live with more clarity, confidence, passion, and impact–especially in midlife and beyond–come join the conversation.
Let’s get candid on calling.

author: Marco R. Torres
description:
The Talking TACMED Audio Series

One skill. Twenty minutes. No guests, no fluff.

TACMED TWENTY is the audio side of Talking TACMED, hosted by Dr. Marco R. Torres — physician, flight and critical care paramedic, Navy veteran, and founder of MED-TAC International.

Each episode takes a single tactical medicine skill and works it to the ground: what kills, what the doctrine actually says, how it fails in the field, and a drill you can run today with no equipment.

What makes this show different is what happens at the end of every episode. Doc states the evidence tier out loud and names at least one specific gap in it. Manufacturer claims get labeled as manufacturer claims. When the show gets something wrong, the correction is made on-mic, in the episode.

Four times a season, that habit becomes its own format: the Claim Audit, where a claim everyone repeats gets traced back to what it actually rests on.

For law enforcement, fire, EMS, military, and anyone who has decided they are not going to stand there and watch.

Free field guides and reference cards at tactical-medicine.com — no cost, no course to buy first.

Clinician founded. Veteran led. Service-disabled veteran-owned. South Florida, US of A.

Through contemporary cases, legal analysis, and political history, Toward Reconstitution asks what it would take to build a constitutional order bound by relational integrity—where rights place duties on those with power and harm creates an obligation to repair.

Jekyll; or, The Doctor's Records is a gothic audio fiction series adapted from the debut novel by Theodore Siren and performed by the author — scored for atmosphere, sound, and dread by Paradigm Logic Studios. Each chapter unfolds a world where the fog of Whitechapel never quite lifts, where Frankenstein's monster is a rumor passed between the wrong kind of people, and where a man who cannot die must eventually reckon with everything that kept him living.

New episodes release weekly. The story concludes December 25th.

We are tearing down the corporate business methodologies, the manipulation of the five-fold ministry, the abuse of tithes, and the false, demonic stronghold of male dominion in the body of Christ.
​This isn't religious entertainment, and we aren't here to protect human empires. Strip away the modern cultural influences and the human-made hierarchies, and what remains?
​Rooted strictly in original Scrip

author: Alicia and Savanah
description: Welcome to “Weighting for the OOOOOs” where Olympic obsession meets real-life friendship, fitness, and fun. Alicia is counting down to the 2028 Games with tickets in hand and a goal to get healthier before the big event, while Savanah is along for the ride with her own goals of losing weight and learning more about the Olympics. Each week we spotlight an incredible female Olympian, celebrate strength and determination, and share the highs, lows, laughs, and lessons of our weight loss and fitness journeys.

title: Shit Show with Dan
author: Daniel Maude
description: Shit Show with Dan is the podcast where no topic is off limits and every episode is guaranteed to be a laugh. Each week, Dan sits down with a new guest to chat about real life, funny stories, relationships, trending gossip, and the latest celebrity headlines. From unforgettable moments to hot takes and everything in between, expect honest conversations, plenty of laughs, and a little bit of chaos.

title: Attitudes, Beliefs and Obligation
author: karen
description: In this podcast, I will talk about my attitudes, beliefs, and obligations in my academic and workplace contexts. First, I will introduce myself and provide some basic information. Then, I will explain the importance of having a positive attitude, being responsible, respectful, and committed. Finally, I will mention some of my obligations using have to, must, and should, and explain how these responsibilities help me achieve my academic and professional goals.

title: Death and Sunshine
author: Cosmo and Luna Rose
description: Death & Sunshine is where opposites collide. Join Cosmo and Luna Rose as they dive into today's hottest topics with curiosity, humor, and honest conversation. From relationships and social trends to controversial debates and life's biggest questions, nothing is off limits. Whether they agree, disagree, or completely surprise each other, every episode is an open-minded exploration that invites you to think, laugh, and join the conversation.

title: Lisa Cheng Piano 麗莎的鋼琴與故事
author: Lisa Cheng
description:
Welcome to Lisa Cheng Piano, a creative audio journal by pianist, novelist, and artist Lisa Cheng. This is a space where music, storytelling, and personal artistry meet. Each episode blends intimate reflections, piano moments, creative philosophy, and the behind‑the‑scenes life of a modern artist. From practice insights to fashion inspiration, from the emotional world of music to the discipline behind creativity, Lisa shares her artistic journey with honesty, elegance, and depth. 
由鋼琴家、小說家與藝術家 Lisa Cheng 打造的創意聲音誌。這裡是一個讓音樂、故事敘述與個人藝術性相互交織的空間。

title: Ask Samantha
author: Samantha Earley
description:
Hosted by Samantha Earely, MS, LPC
Welcome to Ask Samantha, a mental health podcast for anxiety, exposure therapy, and as a resource in between your sessions. Combining humor, evidence based chats, and real life.

title: Eight-six at Forty: The Forgotten Finals
author: Scott McGill and Martin J. Siegel
description: 86 at 40 takes a close look at a forgotten NBA rivalry of the 1980s between the Boston Celtics and Houston Rockets on the the 40th anniversary of their 1986 championship series. Hosted by a classics professor who's a diehard Celtics fan and a law professor who bleeds Rockets red, the eight-part podcast goes beyond Xs and Os to cover the cities' sports histories and cultures, race and cocaine in the '80s NBA, and the post-series decline of both franchises due to drugs, injuries, and the tragic death of Len Bias. An absorbing look at an overlooked but fascinating slice of hoops history.

title: Cuomo Crime Time
author: cuomocrimetime
description: Every full episode of Cuomo Crime Time in one place. Chris Cuomo sits down with crime reporters, attorneys, and investigators to break down the country's mos...

title: Customer Engagement Champions
author: MoEngage Catalyst
description:
Move beyond generic MarTech talk. 
The MoEngage Champions series features highly focused, thought-provoking conversations with our top ecosystem partners from across the globe. 
Learn how to leverage Data, AI, and modern composable architecture to solve today's complex customer engagement challenges.

title: Loves, Hates and Passions
author: Lyn Stone
description:
Welcome to Loves, Hates and Passions, the podcast ABOUT educators. 
I’m your host, Lyn Stone, and I love reading books and articles on education and I love hearing the leading lights in the field talk about their work, but often, I’m curious to find out their backstory. 
What makes them tick? What are their likes and dislikes? Who are their influences both in an outside education? What do they like doing besides writing and presenting?
In this increasingly impersonal world, this podcast takes an intimate view of the humans behind the ideas.

title: Agape Love
author: Maya
description:
Agape Love is a podcast about the extraordinary, unconditional love parents have for their children with disabilities and neurodivergence—and the strength, grief, joy, resilience, and community that grow from that love.  Agape Love isn't a podcast about autism. It's a podcast about the parents who love children with disabilities with a kind of love that has no conditions and no expiration date. 


Who needs to hear this?

 

This podcast is for the mother who just heard the words, “Your child has autism,” and has no idea what tomorrow looks like.

 

It’s for the mother whose child wandered away from home and was found in a dangerous situation—and who still replays those terrifying moments in her mind.

 

It’s for the mother who feels like no one in her family truly understands what life is like inside her home.

 

It’s for the mother carrying guilt because one child needs so much of her that her other children receive what’s left.

 

It’s for the mother who wishes co-parenting looked different—who longs for someone else to understand, advocate, and share the weight of this journey.

 

It’s for the mother who hasn’t slept through the night in years because her child doesn’t sleep.

 

It’s for the mother who constantly thinks three steps ahead because safety is never something she can take for granted.

 

It’s for the mother who dreams about self-care but can’t imagine finding the time, the support, or the resources to make it possible.

 

It’s for the mother whose heart overflows with joy when her child sings in a choir concert, says a new word, makes a friend, or simply experiences a moment of belonging.

 

It’s for the mother who wants nothing more than for her child to experience kindness, acceptance, dignity, and the goodness this world has to offer.

 

Most of all, it’s for the parent who has ever whispered to themselves, “I feel so alone.”

 

I want them to know they aren’t.

 

Because somewhere, another parent is carrying the very same hope, fear, exhaustion, and unconditional love.

 

Agape Love is where those parents find each other.

 

It’s where we remind one another that while this journey can feel incredibly lonely, we never have to walk it alone.

title: Tapestry Church Stouffville
author: Tapestry Church
description: Weekly Sermons from Tapestry Church Stouffville. We are creating a dwelling place for the presence of God in Stouffville.

title: Tóxica Tarot
author: Carla Corazón
description:
Tóxica Tarot is a show. 22 episodes, one for each archetype in the Major Arcana.


We're exploring their shadows and how they get reflected back at us in those we call tóxicas.


Twenty-two archetypes. One card a week. Each one is an expired survival strategy gone toxic. You pull the card. You name the shadow. You decide if it hits.


This deck is for anyone with a shadow. The fem lens is intentional.


Not Saints, Ni Tóxicas.

description: Late night talk radio

title: Black Manayunk Stories
author: Black Manayunk
description:
Manayunk's history has always been told through its mills, its rowhomes, and its Main Street. Almost never told is who the Black laborers and families were who helped build it.
Black Manayunk: Unseen Hands is a podcast recovering that missing history through oral histories, interviews, and conversations with descendants, elders, and researchers. Each episode digs into migration, labor, faith, and everyday life in Manayunk's Black community, told in the words of the people who lived it.
This isn't just a history podcast. It's a living, community-owned archive, one story at a time.

title: Mommy Issues with Lucas Zelnick
author: Lucas Zelnick
description: My mom gives the best advice so I started a Podcast series with my mother where my fans and followers can submit their questions and issues and we'll do our best to provide you with the best advice and guidance a mother and her son can offer.

description: Welcome to Bottom Line Ag, hosted by Brad Jensen. Powered by Agri-Search, this show breaks down the critical strategies, talents, and market trends shaping the modern agricultural industry. Whether you're an agribusiness leader building a high-performing team or a professional navigating your ag career, we deliver straight-talking insights, expert interviews, and actionable advice to boost your bottom line. No fluff—just real strategy for real ag results.

title: Resurrection Episcopal Church
author: reslargo
description:
Listen to our Sunday sermons from Resurrection Episcopal Church in Largo, FL.

We are an Episcopal community in central Pinellas County.

When you're here, you're home!

title: Living in the Tension
author: Steven Zeier
description:
Living in the Tension is a conversation for anyone trying to follow Jesus in a world that hasn't been fully redeemed yet. We will explore what it actually looks like to hold onto faith when life is complicated.
This is for the person who has hard questions. Who wants to live with conviction but doesn't have everything figured out. Who feels the pull between the sacred and the everyday, and is learning to live faithfully in the middle of it.
No easy answers. No pretending it's simple. Just honest conversations about what it means to be devoted to Christ in the tension of real life.

title: Straight to the CORe
author: Colour of Research
description:
Everyone talks about inclusion. We talk about what actually needs to change.
Straight to the CORe is Colour of Research's podcast where people bring one hot take on inclusion in market research, unpack why they believe it, and challenge us to think differently. Hosted by Annabelle Jones and Cathia Randrianarivo from CORe's (Colour of Research) steering team, each episode goes beyond good intentions to explore ideas, tensions and actions that will shape a more inclusive future for our industry. 
Honest conversations. Bold opinions. Real change. Straight to the CORe.

title: How To Not Lose Your Sh!t
author: Red Wine & Blue
description:
Want to know how you can make a difference without losing your sh!t?
Join Katie Paris and LaFonda Cousin, two moms with very different backgrounds who together run Red Wine & Blue – an organization of over half a million diverse suburban women working together to defeat extremism. Katie, the org’s founder, has worked in political organizing for most of her career. LaFonda, the Chief People Officer, is a wellness expert on a mission to reimagine self-care.
Each week, LaFonda and Katie talk to experts and everyday women who are getting involved, building community, and feeling better in the process.

title: Living In Queendom Recap with Arlesia
author: Arlesia Cummings
description: Queens, welcome to your Friday Night Living in Queendom Recap with Arlesia! Your weekly catch‑up on everything we dropped this past Wednesday. If you missed the latest post, don’t worry. Tonight I'm pulling it all together, highlighting the crown lessons and the royal reminders that help you wear yoru crown with confidence. And don't forget to check out new content at www.livinginqueendom.com.

title: Fully Deeply Human
author: Trish Leichty MD
description:
I'm tired of living in the fake, and I'm pretty sure you might be tired of it too! 


The hiding, pretending, performing, and shapeshifting we've been taught to keep us 'safe' in this world and in our relationships just isn't working.


I've spent the past thirty years dedicated to unraveling myself and others from the 'fake' in families, religious and spiritual communities, and culture. I've experienced and learned a lot along the way, and now I get to share it with you!


FYI... I love to cuss. Never at humans, but at the ridiculous systems and programs of belief that have conditioned us to live small and afraid. If this offends you, I'm not your girl!


If you're interested in more of my work, please sign up for my weekly newsletter or head over to my website:


https://trishleichty.com

title: Hello Satan
author: International Scherick
description: The planet is going insane.  It's getting worse every day.  That's because humanity is locked in an epic contest between good and evil.  It's a spiritual battle of immense significance and scope.  It's raging right now, and we're in it.  Satan is hell-bent on destroying humanity.  And here's the bad news: he's winning!  That's why everything is so crazy and troubling on the planet.  The forces of darkness have tightened their death-grip on earth in an outright and unbridled bid for total domination.  Humans are targeted for subjugation, enslavement and death.  And still most of us don't believe Satan is real.  That's about to change.  Hello, Satan.

Confused astronaut Elmer Walton wakes up alone in space with a polite alien parasite living in the ship's AI. Every week he sends increasingly unhinged voicemails to random Earth answering machines. Comedy sci-fi at its dumbest.
Hello Earthling

description: Two friends, one long conversation, and no agreed subject. Episodes run through economics, faith, farming, travel, culture and whatever else we find genuinely interesting. The organizing promise is not a subject, it is the pairing: an economist who distrusts permanent systems, and an engineer who wants the mechanism. Same argument, two instruments.

title: The Edinburgh Fringe Comedy Podcast
author: RGB Monster
description: Produced by RGB Monster, listen to a chit chat between comedians at the Edinburgh Fringe recorded in front of a live audience. Insider tips, show recommendations, and more!

title: CIC’s Connected In Faith
author: Christians In Communications
description: Connected In Faith Podcast by Christians In Communications brings together professionals across the communications industry who are navigating their careers while staying grounded in their faith. Through conversations on leadership, ethics, technology, and culture, this podcast explores what it looks like to follow Christ in a fast-moving, ever-changing communications landscape.

title: Hope for the Cancer+ Journey Podcast
author: hopeforthecancerjourney
description:
Hope for the Cancer Journey is a compassionate, faith-based podcast for cancer patients, survivors, caregivers, and loved ones walking through the emotional, spiritual, and physical realities of cancer.

As a stage 3 non-smoker’s lung cancer survivor, Debbie understands the shock, fear, sorrow, and uncertainty that can come with a diagnosis, as well as the challenges of navigating treatment and the medical community.

Through heartfelt interviews, practical tips, survivor stories, and biblical encouragement, Debbie offers hope and support to help listeners face the cancer journey with purpose, prayer, and strength.

Each episode includes real-life encouragement for patients, survivors, and caregivers, with practical takeaways for treatment, survivorship, healing, and life beyond diagnosis.

For more biblical teaching and encouragement, we invite you to listen to Debbie’s other podcast, the Debbie Taylor Williams Podcast.

title: The Female STEM Society
author: The Female STEM Society
description: Women make up roughly 35% of STEM graduates, and many of them feel intimidated to pursue those fields because of the male dominance. With each episode, we’re hoping to empower women from all around the world to step into the diverse fields of STEM with confidence!

title: TwoCentsaDay
author: MahoganyIsHere
description: Life, growth, and skin confidence the Upglow way. Served daily, with honesty and real talk.

title: The Honest Playbook Podcast
author: Honest Playbook
description:
We're two guys in our 40s sharing the lessons that weren't taught — they were earned. We're not experts. We're not motivational speakers. Every episode is a conversation we wish we'd had 20 years ago.
Two men. Real conversations.
No script. No pretense.

title: Running Down The Hill: Little House On The Prairie Original Series Recaps
author: Steve Barnes
description: On Running Down The Hill, we have a guest join us, and we get to know them by watching and discussing a Little House On The Prairie episode. Our show is hosted by Steve Barnes of Introvoid and Sweet Child of Time, who is a longtime fan of the original series, and was lucky enough to help promote the new Netflix Little House Series. Steve is armed with behind the scenes show facts, book knowledge, as well as the real Ingalls family history. On Running Down The Hill, we focus on our favorite episodes and deep dive into the world of Walnut Grove 1870's!

title: Elektrodinosaur Podcats
author: Elektrodinosaur
description: Elektrodinosaur talk. Dino Dave, Justasaurus, and their various guests discuss current issues, pop culture, and more, but really don't know anything, except their own music.
