author: Natural Bros Media
description: A group of friends sharing there thoughts and beliefs

title: The Preface
author: The Collect with Joanna Aitken and Deborah Chelchowska
description: The Preface is a Catholic podcast that explores scripture, theology, liturgy and the spiritual life through thoughtful conversation. Each episode asks honest questions, draws from the richness of Catholic tradition and aims to deepen understanding without losing sight of the heart of the Faith. Every discussion serves as a preface to prayer, concluding with a guided Lectio Divina to help listeners encounter Christ in His Word.

title: Digital Footprint
author: Jason Sappy
description: Uncovering the story behind the internet's most viral moments. Watch your step.

title: Bible Bits & Morning Brew Podcast
author: Joel
description:
Bible Bits & Morning Brew

 Pause. Reflect. Create.

Join me each week as we open God’s Word, read a verse, and explore what it means for our lives as creatives, storytellers, and makers. Short, inspiring, and practical — this podcast is your weekly dose of Scripture and reflection, paired with a cozy cup of inspiration. At the end of each month, we dive deeper into a theme, connecting faith, creativity, and everyday life.

title: Motherhood on Trial
author: Unspoken Truths Media
description:
Motherhood on Trial examines the difficult intersection of motherhood, maternal mental health, criminal justice, and public judgment.
Through cases involving postpartum psychosis, child loss, grief, and the courtroom, we look beyond the headlines to ask harder questions about accountability, prevention, and compassion.
Because motherhood, mental illness, and justice deserve more than a headline.

title: Addicted Hunting Podcast
author: Addicted Hunting
description: Welcome to the Addicted Hunting Podcast, where passionate hunters come together to learn, laugh, and share the stories that make hunting more than just a season. Join Marlin LeFever, John Anderson, Cliff Sallee, and guests from across the hunting world as they dive into elk, deer, bear, turkey, waterfowl, predator hunting, gear, tactics, scouting, conservation, and the lessons learned in the field. From educational how to episodes to unforgettable hunting stories and honest conversations about the outdoor lifestyle, our goal is to educate, entertain, and inspire hunters of every experience level. Whether you're preparing for your next hunt or just counting down the days until opening morning, this is the podcast for hunters who are truly addicted to the outdoors.

title: Kids On Air
author: Amelie Iffland
description:
Welcome to Kids on Air! 
What do 11-year-olds talk about when adults aren't listening? You're about to find out. Hosted by kids, for kids, this podcast covers completely random topics and conversations. No boring adults ..... just Aussie kids keeping it 100% real. If you love funny stories, random trivia, and hanging out with awesome hosts, this is your new favourite show.

title: Addressing Outdated Policies In  America
author: Dr. Sam Weah Monboe
description:
Addressing Outdated Policies in America is a long‑form documentary podcast that examines the laws, systems, and public policies that no longer serve the people they were designed to protect. Through cinematic narration, historical context, and investigative storytelling, each episode explores a single outdated American policy — from child support enforcement and immigration reform to healthcare failures, criminal justice practices, and other social systems in need of modernization.

This podcast is created for listeners who want to understand why certain policies remain unchanged, how they impact everyday Americans, and what history reveals about the path forward. Every episode is crafted as a standalone documentary, offering deep research, compelling narration, and clear explanations of complex issues.

If you’re interested in American policy reform, social justice, government systems, or documentary‑style storytelling, this series delivers a powerful, accessible look at the policies shaping our lives — and the urgent need to update them.

title: Better in Bed with The Sleep Doctor
author: Lemonada Media, Sleep Doctor
description: Everybody seems to be obsessed with sleep. Tracking it. Talking about it. Stressing over it. Losing (more) sleep over it. But what about actually getting better at it? Sleep Doctor Michael J. Breus combines science, storytelling, and practical advice to leave listeners with the tools they need to improve their sleep and their entire lives. Whether you’re entering menopause, trying to get your kid down for a nap, or overwhelmed by which sleep supplements are worth your money, Dr. Breus and his expert guests are here to help you sleep better. Better in Bed is a new series from Lemonada Media, created in partnership with Sleep Doctor.

title: Better Than Average average people
author: lindsaymardell
description: Serious People.  Unserious Conversation.

title: Get Sweaty with Leddy
author: Josh Leddy
description: Get Sweaty with Leddy is a wellness channel dedicated to pain management. The creator, Josh Leddy, has lived with chronic pain since 1995 and is hellbent on preventing people from the cyclical trap of doctor visits, prescriptions, pain pills, and surgery through natural processes. The goal is to provide numerous avenues to address all types of pain from: physical, mental, visible, invisible, internal, external, work-related, sport-related, acute, chronic, neuropathic, and more.

title: The Diagnosis and Us
author: Diagnosis and Us
description: When one sister, a textiles teacher, was diagnosed with stage 4 bowel cancer in early 2025, the other - a doctor - became more than family. The Diagnosis and Us is their frank, unfiltered conversation about living with cancer: what it's really like to go through it, and what the medicine actually means. One sister shares the lived reality of treatment, fear, and hope. The other brings clear medical insight and her own personal story of watching someone she loves face the disease. No jargon, no false comfort—just two sisters talking honestly about the hardest thing they've faced together.

title: Her Cut
author: Woman Made Films
description:
Her Cut is a podcast from Woman Made Films dedicated to celebrating the women who shape the film industry. Through conversations with directors, writers, producers, cinematographers, editors, sound designers, and other creatives, we explore the stories behind the work, the paths that led them to filmmaking, and the challenges and triumphs of building a career in the industry.
Whether you're an aspiring filmmaker, a lifelong movie lover, or simply curious about the people behind the camera, Her Cut offers thoughtful conversations about creativity, representation, and the power of storytelling.

title: Generational Health with Lillie Brinker
author: Lillie Brinker
description: We are on mission to develop healthy communities to impact future generations with a healthy mind, body and spirit.

title: the Pathfinder Podcast
author: Bogdan
description: the Pathfinder is a long-form podcast exploring discipline, human behavior, relationships, business, psychology, and personal transformation. Hosted by Bogdan, each episode features honest conversations with psychologists, authors, entrepreneurs, athletes, creators, and individuals who have overcome extraordinary challenges. New episodes every Saturday, with practical insights to help you build a stronger mind, purpose-driven life, and lasting discipline.

title: You Go First with Sierra Isaac
author: Sierra Isaac
description:
Before the business.
Before the bestseller.
Before the career change.
Before the leap....
There's an invisible journey almost no one talks about.
The fear.
The uncertainty.
The inner work.
The mornings you questioned yourself.
The choice to keep going when there was no evidence it would work.
You Go First is a podcast about the inner journey behind the outer success.
Each episode explores the problem that started it all, what changed inside before anything changed outside, the courage to take the first step, and how that journey became a business, mission, book, or movement that's now helping others.
Every breakthrough begins with an unseen decision.
Someone has to go first.

title: Borderlines with That Semite
author: Unpacked
description:
Apartheid. White supremacy. Zionism. Palestinian identity. The future of Judaism. Israel’s relationship with its Arab neighbours. These are conversational landmines, the kind that end dinner parties and friendships, and that most people dare not touch.

This show walks straight through the minefield.

Yirmiyahu Danzig (@that_semite) is known for confronting the conversations most people avoid, bringing strong convictions but also a rare willingness to engage people who see the world differently. Caribbean, Ashkenazi, and Palestinian-Jewish by descent, he has built an online following of millions by refusing the usual scripts and narratives, crossing traditionally hard-set ideological borders by speaking to everyone in the language of genuine, openhearted curiosity.

On Borderlines, he brings that approach to the most contested subjects in Israel and Jewish life, taking the big questions seriously enough to resist easy answers. Haredim and secular Israelis. Zionism and its critics. Palestinians, Arab citizens of Israel and the wider Arab world. What Judaism is becoming, and who gets to decide. These are conversations with experts and insiders who understand the issues but are willing to be challenged, and where the familiar arguments and talking points simply won’t cut it.

Come for the questions you've been afraid to ask. Stay because someone's finally looking for honest answers.

Brought to you by Unpacked. New episodes weekly.
